name: Foreign Terrorist Fighter Travel and Support Financing
description: Individuals who travel to join terrorist groups abroad, and networks that support them, finance their journeys through personal funds, loans, family transfers and cash. Financial signals typically cluster around the preparatory period before travel and continue through remittances to the destination region.

sources.text: FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
UN Security Council Resolution 2178 (2014) on foreign terrorist fighters

exposure.rationale: Pre-travel account emptying, borrowing and ATM use abroad.

indicators.name: Closure of accounts and withdrawal of savings before travel
indicators.canon: Closure of accounts and withdrawal of savings before travel
indicators.desc: Customer empties accounts, cancels commitments or sells possessions in a short interval without clear purpose.
indicators.ctx: Customer empties accounts, cancels commitments or sells possessions in a short interval without clear purpose.
indicators.fp: Emigration, study abroad and relocation are common legitimate reasons.

indicators.name: Card and ATM use at transit points near conflict zones
indicators.canon: Cash or card use in border and transit areas near conflict zones
indicators.desc: Cash withdrawals, ATM or card use occur at transit points or border regions near conflict zones.
indicators.ctx: Card or ATM activity in locations commonly used as transit routes to conflict areas, followed by cessation of usage.
indicators.fp: Tourism, trade, humanitarian and diaspora travel produce overlapping footprints.

indicators.name: Remittances from family or associates to individuals in border areas
indicators.canon: Remittances from family or associates to individuals in border areas
indicators.desc: Recurrent small transfers to recipients in or near conflict zones with no clear family relationship or humanitarian need.
indicators.ctx: Recurrent small transfers to recipients in or near conflict zones with no clear family relationship or humanitarian need.
indicators.fp: Diaspora families routinely support relatives in affected regions.

indicators.name: Loans or credit taken with no repayment intent
indicators.canon: Loans or credit taken with no repayment intent
indicators.desc: Customer obtains borrowing and then leaves the jurisdiction, defaulting.
indicators.ctx: Customer obtains borrowing and then leaves the jurisdiction, defaulting.
indicators.fp: Job loss and financial trouble cause defaults.

indicators.name: Purchase of equipment commonly carried by fighters
indicators.canon: Purchase of equipment commonly carried by fighters
indicators.desc: Retail purchases of outdoor, protective, communication or medical gear in unusual quantity shortly before travel.
indicators.ctx: Retail purchases of outdoor, protective, communication or medical gear in unusual quantity shortly before travel.
indicators.fp: Hiking, camping and humanitarian volunteering generate the same purchases.

indicators.name: Connections to known facilitators or recruiters
indicators.canon: Dealings with known facilitators or persons on investigative watch lists
indicators.desc: Customer transacts, including in small amounts, with persons identified in public or law-enforcement material as facilitators or subjects of prior reports.
indicators.ctx: Customer transacts with parties identified in public or law enforcement material as facilitators of travel.
indicators.fp: Social contacts and shared community groups cause innocent links.

indicators.name: Travel booked to destination near conflict via indirect route
indicators.canon: Travel booked to destination near conflict via indirect route
indicators.desc: Itineraries with unusual routing, one-way tickets and short-notice booking inconsistent with customer profile.
indicators.ctx: Itineraries with unusual routing, one-way tickets and short-notice booking inconsistent with customer profile.
indicators.fp: Budget travellers, migrants and workers regularly use multi-leg routes.

indicators.name: Minors or young adults funded by third parties
indicators.canon: Minors or young adults funded by third parties
indicators.desc: Accounts of young customers receive small repeated funds from unrelated adults, followed by cash-out.
indicators.ctx: Accounts of young customers receive small repeated funds from unrelated adults, followed by cash-out.
indicators.fp: Gifting from relatives and part-time work are normal.
